method.process_order: even pair index baseline->candidate; odd pair index candidate->baseline
method.scenario_order: six scenarios round-robin within every pair
method.warmup: each scenario once per binary, alternating the binary-first order by scenario index
method.ci: Student-t df=14 in the log domain, then exponentiated; t(0.975,14)=2.1447866879169273
method.direction: all values are latency; lower is better
method.cold_correctness: candidate build_count must equal rounds; baseline build_count is retained and may exceed rounds
method.warm_contention_correctness: build_count must equal one and checksum must equal the shared operation count on both sides
method.exclusions: none; all completed observations are retained
